dissents.topic: Whether duplicate db.sh entries (regular file + symlink) should block merge

positions.position: The recipe creates egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh, which is the standard pattern in all other recipes. The TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh was also edited to add TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads. This is the correct convention and not a duplication.

No conflict — the recipe-level db.sh is a symlink to the template, which means it picks up the new TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH variable from TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. This is fine and consistent with other recipes.

dissents.topic: Whether the missing exit on unzip-not-installed is a real bug

positions.position: In local/download_and_untar.sh the `if ! command -v unzip` branch prints a message but does not `exit`, so the script will continue and the subsequent `unzip` invocations will fail with a less clear error. This should be an exit 1.
set -euo pipefail will cause the subsequent unzip call to fail and abort the script. Output will be slightly noisier but behavior is still safe. Worth fixing but not blocking.

issues.description: README links to a non-existent config path
issues.detail: README.md links the ASR config as ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml, but the file is actually at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml (no train/ subdir). The link is broken and will 404 in the rendered README.

issues.description: download_and_untar.sh prints unzip-missing warning but does not exit
issues.detail: The check `if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null; then echo ...` only echoes a message and falls through. Combined with set -euo pipefail the subsequent unzip call will fail with a confusing error rather than the intended clear message. Add `exit 1` inside the branch.

issues.description: Usage block in download_and_untar.sh missing exit on wrong argc
issues.detail: When invoked with the wrong number of arguments, the script prints the Usage block but does not exit, so execution continues with unset or wrong values of $1/$2. Add `exit 1` after the Usage heredoc.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions in download_and_untar.sh break on paths with spaces
issues.detail: `extract_dir=$(realpath $1)` and `zip_dir=$(realpath ${2:-$extract_dir})` do not quote $1 / $2, so paths containing spaces will be split. Quote as `$(realpath "$1")` and `$(realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}")`.

issues.description: data.sh sources download_and_untar.sh with `.` instead of executing it
issues.detail: `. ./local/download_and_untar.sh "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}" "${downloads_dir}"` sources the script into the current shell. Because download_and_untar.sh sets its own positional args from $1/$2, and contains `set -euo pipefail`, sourcing it changes the parent shell's options and pollutes its environment. Most other ESPnet recipes invoke it with `./local/download_and_untar.sh ...`. This is fragile.

data.sh accepts a `--downloads_dir` flag (parsed via parse_options.sh) but then calls `download_and_untar.sh "${TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH}" "${downloads_dir}"`. If the user does not pass --downloads_dir, downloads_dir is empty, and download_and_untar.sh receives an empty second arg, which due to the unquoted `realpath ${2:-$extract_dir}` actually still works — but the script treats argc==2 with an empty string as 2 args and will set zip_dir = realpath of empty string ('.'). The behavior depends on subtle bash positional semantics and should be made explicit (omit the second arg, or pass an explicit default).

issues.description: Hardcoded utterance counts make recipe brittle to dataset revisions
issues.detail: data.sh enforces exact line counts (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924) via `wc -l != num_wav`. If TAL ever republishes the corpus with even one corrected/dropped transcript the recipe will hard-fail with no easy override. Consider warning instead of erroring, or making the check optional behind a flag.

issues.description: Train/dev/test split deviates from the 7:1:2 ratio claimed in PR description
issues.detail: PR says split is 7:1:2 train/val/test. Actual counts in data.sh are train ≈ 90,777 (22467+29386+38924), dev=3208, test=6072, ratio roughly 91:3:6. The README/PR description is inconsistent with the recipe. Either clarify the description or document why dev/test are smaller.

issues.description: Sed-based transcript cleanup is fragile and undocumented
issues.detail: The chain `sed 's/Ａ/A/g' | sed 's/#//g' | sed 's/=//g' | sed 's/、//g' | sed 's/，//g' | sed 's/？//g' | sed 's/。//g' | sed 's/[ ][ ]*$//g'` mixes fullwidth normalization, punctuation stripping, and trailing-whitespace trimming with no explanation. Collapsing into one sed -e ... -e ... call or moving to a small python normalizer would be clearer and faster. Also: this strips Chinese punctuation but leaves ASCII punctuation, which seems arbitrary.

issues.description: Speaker IDs are derived from immediate parent dir, which may collide across the three archives
issues.detail: `utt2spk` uses `TALASR$(NF-1)` as speaker ID, where NF-1 is the immediate parent dir of the wav. If two of the three archives (aisolution_data, CH, MA) contain a subdir with the same name (e.g. both have a `wav` dir), distinct speakers would be merged. Worth confirming the corpus structure guarantees uniqueness.

issues.description: decode_asr_branchformer.yaml sets lm_weight: 0.7 but run.sh defaults use_lm=false
issues.detail: The decode config sets lm_weight: 0.7 which is only meaningful when use_lm=true. The default run path won't use the LM, so this is silently ignored. Either set use_lm=true to match the published LM-rescored results, or note in README that lm_weight applies only with use_lm.

issues.description: train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml has typo-like float values that work but are unusual
issues.detail: `self_attention_dropout_rate: 0.` and `src_attention_dropout_rate: 0.` (trailing dot) and `time_mask_width_ratio_range: [0., 0.05]` are valid YAML floats but inconsistent with the rest of the file using `0.0`. Cosmetic.

issues.description: README header is empty / has stray blank line
issues.detail: README.md begins with a blank line before `# Branchformer Results`. Minor formatting nit.

Multiple symlinked entry-point files (asr.sh, db.sh, path.sh, pyscripts, scripts, steps, utils) are flagged `\ No newline at end of file`. This is harmless for symlinks but inconsistent with other recipes that may end with newlines. Trivial nit.

issues.description: Typos and grammar in YAML comments
No CITATION / LICENSE note for TAL dataset
issues.detail: The TAL Open Data has specific usage terms. Other ESPnet recipes (e.g. talromur) include a short note about license/usage. Consider adding a one-liner pointing to the TAL terms in the README.

review.summary: This is a standard ESPnet recipe-addition PR (new egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1) with the typical scaffold of symlinks, configs, and a data prep script. No P0 blockers: the architecture follows the established pattern, results table is plausible, and the changes are scoped to the new recipe plus one line in TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. The main P1 issues are in local/download_and_untar.sh (missing exit on bad argc and missing unzip, unquoted realpath args), the sourced-vs-executed invocation of that script from data.sh, a broken README link to the ASR config, and an inconsistency between the PR description's 7:1:2 split claim and the actual ~91:3:6 split implied by the hardcoded counts. P2 items are stylistic/robustness nits: brittle transcript sed chain, possible speaker-ID collisions across archives, lm_weight set despite use_lm=false default, and minor typos.
